overview: The Holistic Development of Islands (Andaman & Lakshadweep) scheme aims to promote sustainable and inclusive development in the islands of Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep through infrastructure development, livelihood generation, tourism promotion, and environmental conservation. It focuses on improving basic amenities, enhancing economic opportunities, and preserving the unique ecological and cultural heritage of the islands.
objectives: Develop sustainable infrastructure in the islands
Enhance basic amenities such as water, electricity, and connectivity
Preserve and promote indigenous culture and heritage
Strengthen disaster resilience and climate adaptation
eligibility: Beneficiaries include local residents, self-help groups, cooperatives, NGOs, and private enterprises operating in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep, subject to project viability and alignment with scheme guidelines.
benefits: Financial assistance for infrastructure projects, livelihood support through skill training and market linkages, promotion of eco-friendly tourism, conservation of natural resources, improved access to basic services, and capacity building for local institutions.
financial_support: The scheme provides financial support in the form of grants and subsidies for approved projects, with funding patterns varying by component and implementing agency, subject to budgetary allocations and utilization norms.
application_process: 1. Identify project proposal aligned with scheme objectives 2. Prepare detailed project report (DPR) 3. Submit application to the nodal department or implementing agency 4. Undergo technical and financial appraisal 5. Obtain approval from the competent authority 6. Execute project upon fund release 7. Submit utilization certificates and progress reports.
required_documents: No Objection Certificate (NOC) from relevant authorities
Bank account details of the applicant
implementing_agency: NITI Aayog Aayog in coordination with the Ministry of Home Affairs and respective Union Territory administrations
caveats: Projects must adhere to environmental and coastal regulation norms
Funding is subject to availability of budget and approval of competent authority
Beneficiaries must ensure maintenance and sustainability of assets post-completion
No duplication of funding from other central or state schemes for the same component
